Hosted Sites update reconciliation changes must prove canonical D1 route ownership, stale-default repair, lifecycle reconciliation, and node routing without selecting the historically red unrelated OS package suite.
Shared generated OS tool manifests, facade schemas, registry metadata, and generated workspace types must prove deterministic generation and syntax without waking unrelated lifecycle execution.

Lifecycle updater, managed ingress dependency convergence, Caddy topology reload decisions, immutable release handoff, worker drain/load-balancer evacuation, detached activation, platform restart, and discoverable lifecycle-tool changes must run the exact lifecycle/facade/tool contracts without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

MCP request admission and dangerous-material boundary changes must prove JSON-RPC transport/error behavior, fail-closed safety, authentication/gateway compatibility, and syntax without selecting the historically broad OS package suite.

Public MCP completion changes must prove that completed upstream responses are not blocked by post-execution bookkeeping, that local received/response-ready receipts remain metadata-only and durable, and that server diagnostics run from the installed runtime without selecting the broad OS package suite.

The JavaScript syntax gate is itself part of verify. Changes must prove Bun-launched runners delegate to Node with a per-file timeout and that the full syntax sweep remains bounded without selecting the broad OS package suite.

ChatGPT node-routing facade or steering changes must prove top-level nodeId discovery, no inner-input leakage, explicit/default/fail-closed routing, and syntax without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Public MCP call timeout is envelope execution metadata, not selected tool input; changes must prove transport separation, local facade deadline propagation, and syntax without selecting the historically red package-wide OS suite.

One-click managed-cloud control-plane, launcher, provisioning-runner, enrollment, and Worker changes must prove their focused security and lifecycle contracts without selecting the historically red unrelated OS package suite.

GitHub App source-control onboarding, installation handoff, workspace repository materialization, and Diffs credential brokering must prove their focused security and UX contracts without selecting the historically red unrelated OS package suite.

Work-session filesystem authority must prove trusted session-root routing, escape resistance, generated tool contracts, and unchanged task-session filesystem behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Work-session Code Call and MCP routing must prove bounded execution, protected Consuelo state, session-authority validation, public schema limits, generated error-code parity, and child-process stdin/exit lifecycle behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
